obligations.statement: The stand must be able to be placed on a desk.
derivation_premises: If the stand cannot be placed on a desk, it cannot fulfill its purpose.

obligations.statement: The three legs must fold in close to the body to achieve a compact configuration.
derivation_premises: For the folded stand to be narrow and compact, the legs must move close to the body.

obligations.statement: No part detaches from the stand during folding.
derivation_premises: If any part detaches during folding, the stand would not remain intact, violating the requirement.

obligations.statement: The folding operation must be achievable without removing any part.
derivation_premises: If a part must be removed to fold, the requirement is violated.

obligations.statement: The user must be able to open the stand by hand with an intuitive sequence.
derivation_premises: If the opening sequence is not intuitive, the user may not be able to open it as intended.

obligations.statement: The three legs must spread apart in different directions to provide a stable footprint on the desk.
derivation_premises: For the stand to have a usable footprint, the legs must be spread apart.

obligations.statement: During opening, no part may detach and no tools or motor may be used.
derivation_premises: If a part detaches or tools are needed, the requirement is violated.

obligations.statement: The open stand must remain open without external support.
derivation_premises: If the stand cannot stay open without support, it would require external means to remain open.

obligations.statement: Legs must not move from the open position or detach during use.
derivation_premises: If legs can move or detach during use, the stand may collapse or fail.

obligations.statement: No unexpected movement of the stand occurs during use.
derivation_premises: If the stand moves unexpectedly, it may not hold the object or could be unsafe.

obligations.statement: The stand must remain open until a deliberate action is performed to fold it.
derivation_premises: If the stand collapses without deliberate action, it would not satisfy the requirement for deliberate folding.

obligations.statement: After deliberate release, the stand must fold to the same compact configuration as initially folded.
derivation_premises: If it does not fold to the same configuration, it would not be repeatable.

obligations.statement: The opening and folding sequence must be repeatable many times without removal of parts.
derivation_premises: If parts are removed during repeated cycles, the sequence is not repeatable without reassembly.

obligations.statement: The stand must be able to hold a small object on a desk during work.
derivation_premises: If the stand cannot hold a small object, it fails its primary function.

obligations.statement: The stand must be manufacturable and assemblable in a sensible order, remaining intact during normal opening and folding.
derivation_premises: If the product cannot be manufactured and assembled sensibly, it cannot exist as a product.

obligations.statement: The stand must incorporate a mechanism that prevents unintended movement or collapse, requiring a deliberate action to fold.
derivation_premises: Without a locking mechanism, the stand may not remain open or stable.

assumptions.statement: The desk is a horizontal, stable surface.
assumptions.why: The stand is meant to be used on a desk, and the footprint refers to a stable base.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the desk is not stable or not horizontal.

assumptions.statement: The user has two hands and normal manual dexterity.
assumptions.why: Opening and folding is to be done by hand without tools.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the user has limited hand function requiring assistive devices.
